capabilities: Export outline bookmarks and page numbers
Set header and footer templates and margins
Merge a folder or linked notes into one PDF
Batch export each note in a folder to its own PDF
extras: README lists a TODO of planned features (internal link footnotes, pagedjs, print CSS) and donation links; CLI export requires the Obsidian 1.12 installer and the command line interface setting.
intentEvidence: adds the ability to export bookmarks outline, export preview and add page numbers
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export offers no preview, no outline bookmarks, no page numbers and no way to combine several notes into one PDF.
summary: PDF export plugin that adds export preview, outline bookmarks, page numbers, header/footer templates, and merged or batch multi-file export.
